content:
alina: noticed invoice preview spike after we started sending X-Route-Hint from proxy. small but consistent across staging tenants.

mike: confirmed ~1.6% on previews. quick check: enricher copies headers into event.meta.debug and invoice transform falls back to debug.price_hint.

soph: that's the leak. Fix proposal: (1) stop copying arbitrary headers to billing metadata; (2) make transform ignore route_* headers unless tenant opt-in.

alina: UX: add a compact note on invoice preview: 'Routing hints used at runtime; not billed unless tenant enables route_billing' so SREs don't get noisy alerts.

mike: telemetry: emit header_leak.metric and pricing_source tag in transform to explain why a price was picked. Also add unit test to prevent header-to-price regressions.

billing-bot: alert: preview-delta=1.62% (staging sample) at 6790000030.

soph: I'll open PR for enricher safelist tonight. plan: canary deploy, monitor header_leak, then update transform with opt-in and audit row for finance.

alina: timeline SGTM. include runbook steps in PR for oncall to compare preview vs settled and how to flip opt-in.

mike: adding e2e that simulates X-Route-Hint values and asserts invoice preview unchanged unless opt-in true. prevents future regressions.

billing-bot: deploy note: enricher-canary running in staging at 6790000055.
